links.outcome: Reading grade level (SMOG) of AI and website phalloplasty patient information
links.effect: Website readability was higher than AI platforms, though not statistically significant (p=0.10). All means exceeded the eighth-grade reading level.
links.quote: All means exceeded the eighth-grade reading level, with AI outperforming websites in understandability and actionability (p<0.0001 and p=0.006).

screen.reason: Evaluates the health literacy, readability, and information quality of generative LLMs compared to standard web search for phalloplasty donor site education without evaluating a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
